corrections.evidence: mobile.de Octavia Limousine (5E): Hoehe 1.461 mm, Radstand 2.686 mm; AutoScout24 1.2 TSI 2013-2019 and autoplenum 2.0 TDI 150 PS (2013-2016) also list 1461 mm. Not a manufacturer sheet, but consistent across databases.

Skoda press release at the 2009 Frankfurt IAA launch (reprinted by The Auto Channel and OneShift): 'the luggage compartment holds 633 litres, expanding to ... 1,865 litres when the rear seats are folded down.' Autohaus.de launch report also 633/1865 l. Manufacturer launch figure overrides ADAC's 603/1835. Applies to all variants of this generation.

Same 2009 Skoda launch press text: 633 l, 1,865 l with rear seats folded. Also https://www.oneshift.com/articles/news/skoda-auto-at-the-frankfurt-international-motor-show/ . Variant-level trunkL/trunkFoldedL (603/1835) should become 633/1865 too.

verification.notes: 19 searches used. Confirmed: Octavia 1Z 4572/1769/1462/2578, 560/1350 l; Octavia 5E 4659/1814/2686, 590/1580 l, G-TEC 460 l; 5E FL 4670/1814/2686, RS 245 4689/1448/2680; Superb Combi 3T 4838/1817/1510 (note: Skoda press says body 1481 mm, 1510 mm incl. standard roof rails), 633/1865 l (FL); Superb Combi 3V 660/1950 l, 1864 width, 2841 wb; Superb I 4803/1765/1469/2803, 462 l (facelift 2006 length 4803/462 l per auto-data.net, so merged entry OK); Superb II Limousine 4838/1817/1462, 565/1670 l; Superb III Limousine 4861/1864/1468/2841, 625/1760 l (Skoda boot page). Unresolved: Superb II wheelbase 2761 (Wikipedia, auto.cz, gebrauchtwagenberater) vs 2758 (ADAC, mobile.de, autoscout24) - no manufacturer sheet found; 3T Combi given 2758, facelift null. Since the 633/1865 figures are Skoda's launch values (2009), the split of 3T Combi into pre-FL/FL based on trunk volume is likely unnecessary. Superb I folded volume 945 l not verified (no source found either way). Superb Combi 3V length 4856 not independently confirmed (carsized gave 4861 for estate, ambiguous).
